title: One word, three machines
notes: Run abba on A, B and the product at once. After each symbol the product is in the pair of A's state and B's state. At the end A accepts (two a's) and B rejects (it ends in a), and for a union one is enough.
ops: start p0; accept p0; p0 a -> p1; p1 a -> p0; p0 b -> p0; p1 b -> p1 | start q0; accept q1; q0 a -> q0; q0 b -> q1; q1 a -> q0; q1 b -> q1
